info.title: Opanel API
info.description: Opanel is an open-source project management tool for human teams and AI agents.

get.description: Reports whether the service can reach its database. Requires no credentials.

200.description: The service and its database are available.

get.description: This document: the OpenAPI 3.1 description of the Opanel API.

post.description: Signs a person in with email and password and sets the session cookie. Public: it cannot require credentials. A wrong password, an unknown email and a deactivated account are answered identically. Must come from the app's own origin.

200.description: Signed in. The session cookie is set.

400.description: The body is not valid.

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin.

413.description: The request body is larger than 512 KiB (code `payload_too_large`).

429.description: Too many attempts (code `rate_limited`), or the server is busy hashing passwords (code `server_busy`). See Retry-After.

post.description:
Ends the current session and clears its cookie. Needs a session, no permission.

Not available to API tokens.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

get.description: Returns the caller's account, permissions and project restriction. A person gets `kind: "human"` and an email; an agent gets `kind: "agent"`, its agent role and scopes, and `projectIds` (null for all projects). Needs a session or an API token, no permission.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

patch.description:
Changes the caller's name and returns the caller as `GET /api/v1/me` does. Needs a session, no permission. Must come from the app's own origin.

Not available to API tokens.

400.description: The body is not valid.

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin.

413.description: The request body is larger than 512 KiB (code `payload_too_large`).

post.description:
Replaces the caller's password after checking the current one, and ends every other session of the account; the session that made the request stays signed in. A wrong current password is a 400 with a field error on `currentPassword`. Limited per account. Needs a session, no permission. Must come from the app's own origin.

Not available to API tokens.

400.description: The body is not valid, or the current password is wrong.

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin.

413.description: The request body is larger than 512 KiB (code `payload_too_large`).

429.description: Too many attempts for this account (code `rate_limited`), or the server is busy hashing passwords (code `server_busy`). See Retry-After.

post.description: First-run setup. Creates the first Admin and signs them in. Public, because before the first account exists there is nobody to authenticate. Once any account exists it answers 404, like an unknown path. Must come from the app's own origin.

201.description: The Admin was created. The session cookie is set when `signedIn` is true.

400.description: The body is not valid.

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin (code `forbidden`), or the server has a setup token configured and the body's is missing or wrong (code `invalid_setup_token`), or the server runs in production with no setup token configured, so setup is locked until one is (code `setup_token_not_configured`).

404.description: The installation is already set up.

413.description: The request body is larger than 512 KiB (code `payload_too_large`).

429.description: The server is busy hashing passwords (code `server_busy`). See Retry-After.

post.summary: Accept an invitation or reset link
post.description: Sets the password of the account a one-time link was issued for, and signs the person in. Public: the token is the credential. Every refusal (unknown, used, expired, replaced, or the account is deactivated) is the same 404 `invalid_link`. All earlier sessions of the account end. Must come from the app's own origin.

200.description: The password was set. The session cookie is set when `signedIn` is true.

400.description: The body is not valid.

403.description: The request does not come from the app's own origin.

413.description: The request body is larger than 512 KiB (code `payload_too_large`).

429.description: Too many attempts from this address (code `rate_limited`), or the server is busy hashing passwords (code `server_busy`). See Retry-After.

get.description:
Lists human accounts, oldest first, with keyset pagination.

Requires the `accounts:manage` permission.

400.description: The query string is not valid.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

post.description:
Creates an account with no password and a one-time link, valid for 7 days, that is shown only in this response. Must come from the app's own origin.

Requires the `accounts:manage` permission.

400.description: The body is not valid.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

413.description: The request body is larger than 512 KiB (code `payload_too_large`).

patch.summary: Change an account's role or activity
patch.description:
Changes the role and/or deactivates or reactivates a human account. A role change or a deactivation ends the account's sessions at once. The only active Admin cannot be demoted or deactivated. Must come from the app's own origin.

Requires the `accounts:manage` permission.

400.description: The path or the body is not valid.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

404.description: There is no such human account.

409.description: The change would leave no active Admin (code `last_admin`).

413.description: The request body is larger than 512 KiB (code `payload_too_large`).

post.summary: Issue a one-time link for an account
post.description:
For an invited account it issues a fresh invitation link, for an active one a password reset link. Earlier unused links of the account stop working. The link is shown only in this response. Must come from the app's own origin.

Requires the `accounts:manage` permission.

400.description: The path is not valid.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

404.description: There is no such human account.

409.description: The account is deactivated.

delete.summary: Revoke an invitation that was never accepted
delete.description:
Removes an invited account that never set a password, with its links, so its email can be invited again. An account that has a password is refused with 409: deactivate it instead. Must come from the app's own origin.

Requires the `accounts:manage` permission.

400.description: The path is not valid.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

404.description: There is no such human account.

409.description: The invitation was already accepted.

get.description:
Server-Sent Events (WS-047): every change to the project's tasks, comments, columns, epics and the project itself, as it is committed. Each event says what changed, not how: read the entity again through its endpoint. Delivery is at most once; after a reconnection, reload what you show. At most 10 streams per account and app process.

Requires the `tasks:read` permission.

parameters.name: projectId

schema.description: The project's id or its key.

parameters.description: The project's id or its key.

200.description: The stream. Each event is a frame `event: <type>` followed by `data: <the event as JSON>`. Lines starting with `:` are comments: `: connected` first, then `: heartbeat` every 25 seconds. `retry: 3000` asks the browser to wait 3 seconds before reconnecting. The stream ends when the session is no longer valid or events may have been missed.

403.description: The actor lacks the permission or scope.

429.description: The account has too many open streams (code `too_many_streams`); `Retry-After` says when to try again.
